latestVersion.changelog:
- Major update: Initial release of x-scraper skill, replacing the previous x-twitter-scraper.
- Simple, read-focused Twitter (X) scraping using Apify; fetch tweets via search queries, profiles, hashtags, lists, or threads.
- Requires a paid Apify plan and API token—free plan returns demo/limited results only.
- All references, docs, and code now focused on Apify-based workflow; 74 legacy and reference files removed.
- Provides detailed guidance for sync/async runs, code integration (Python/JS), and guardrails for user clarity.

raw_record.summary: The best, fastest, and cheapest way to scrape tweets — battle-tested by tens of thousands of customers including enterprise teams. Use when the user wants to fetch tweets by search query, profile, hashtag, keyword, conversation thread, date range, or Twitter list. Uses Twitter advanced search syntax
